source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Run command: ipmitool chassis power off
2. After system is power off,
Run command: ipmitool chassis power status, make sure the power status is off
3. Run command: ipmitool chassis power on
4. After system is power on,
Run command: ipmitool chassis power status, make sure the power status is on

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. All steps reponse are correct.
2. System can power on/off normally.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: BEFORE state = `chassis status`; after `power on`, a second `chassis status` confirms; operator confirms (operator-triggered, PARTIAL).

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL acknowledges state change but implements only power-on/status, omitting Master off/off-status sequence, workload protection, graceful-versus-hard decision, secret safety, bounded polling and boot health.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly treats a full off/status/on/status workflow as CRITICAL with staged approval and recovery.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 982/2291 accepts operator preconditions despite incomplete automation command.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Read-only Power Status cannot replace either transition; Power Soft is a separate graceful-shutdown semantic.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 permits approved tools; ED-35 preserves both off and on transitions; ED-36 treats workload/targets/timeouts as readiness; ED-38 forbids automatic power actions/retries.

original_test_intent: Verify the SUT can transition off and then on through the approved BMC/IPMI path, with correct responses, observed states and healthy recovery.
original_method: After explicit approval and workload protection, capture baseline, execute one approved power-off method, poll until verified off, then issue power-on, poll through boot readiness and health, and leave the SUT in the owner-approved final state.
manual_activity: Owner chooses graceful versus hard off, final state and recovery criteria; operator confirms target/workload and approval before the destructive sequence, and handles abort/escalation. Engineer owns verdict.
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs or expose credentials.
Do not hard-off an active workload without explicit authorization.
Verify off before on and never issue blind repeated power commands.
Stop on target mismatch, timeout, lost management, storage/health/alarm anomaly without automatic retry.
Escalate and leave the SUT only in an approved safe/final state.
agent_execution_scope: Static review validates the sequence/runbook/evidence plan only.
Issue one approved off action and poll canonical status to off.
Issue one on action and monitor state, boot, storage and service health.
Return evidence and final state; never self-approve or retry.
engineer_actions: Approve off method, outage and final state.
Approve timeout, boot/health and recovery criteria.
Authorize the sequence and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and unsafe as coverage: it omits power-off and off-state verification, places secrets in arguments and lacks target/workload/timeouts/boot recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a secret-safe approved off/status/on/status runner with staged approval, bounded polling and console/health recovery; no generic command is authorized here.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master off/status/on/status sequence, Script, Criteria and 5/10-minute values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one staged off-to-on transition with canonical state polling, workload safeguards and verified boot/health recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact approved SUT/BMC pair in a maintenance window.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC, IPMI/ipmitool, state parser and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform chassis power semantics and Project shutdown/boot/recovery runbook.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit target/workload controls, off-method decision, secret handling, bounded polling, boot-health evidence and no-retry recovery while retaining both transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Power-on-only or command success is partial; both actual off and on states plus healthy recovery are required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved target/outage, off method, timing, recovery and staged approval.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Hard off can corrupt data; failed on/boot can strand the SUT and affect dependent services.

project_override_considerations: Alternate BMC/Redfish controls require engineer approval and equivalent off, off-status, on, on-status and recovery coverage; a read-only substitute cannot pass transitions.
expected_evidence: Approval, exact BMC/SUT identity, workload drain and initial state
Authorized off action plus timestamped canonical off-state proof
Authorized on action plus timestamped on/boot-ready proof
No-clear/no-retry audit, approved final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master coherently specifies off/status/on/status. DeepSeek's power-on-only implementation is incomplete review guidance, not source authority.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Transition intent is clear; target, workload, off method, timing and recovery are Project execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores the missing off half and adds workload, target, secret, timing and boot-health controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with CRITICAL hybrid classification and no blind retry.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Rejects incomplete power-on-only command as full coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps state query and graceful soft-off semantics separate.

review_improvement: Prevents a successful power-on response from passing an untested off/on cycle and establishes data-integrity and recovery safeguards.
independent_technical_reasoning: Chassis power off is potentially abrupt and is not equivalent to graceful shutdown. A full case needs two confirmed state transitions and boot/service recovery; command completion alone cannot establish either. Because repeated power actions compound damage, any ambiguous or failed transition must stop without retry.
